description: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred into bank accounts of landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Small and marginal landholding farmer families with cultivable land ownership.
benefits: ₹6,000/year in 3 equal instalments of ₹2,000 directly into bank accounts.
application_process: Online via PM-KISAN portal or CSC center.
name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop failure due to natural risks.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops.
benefits: Financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to natural calamities.
application_process: Apply via PMFBY portal or insurance intermediaries.
name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Solar Powered Pump Set Scheme
description: 70% subsidy for farmers to install off-grid solar powered irrigation pump sets.
eligibility: Farmers in Tamil Nadu with agricultural land and tube wells.
benefits: 70% subsidy on solar pump set installation up to 10 HP.
application_process: Apply via Uzhavan App or Agricultural Engineering Department.
name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Solar Powered Pump Set Scheme

scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
description: Financial assistance to girl students admitted to technical degree/diploma courses.
eligibility: Female students pursuing 1st year Degree/Diploma in AICTE approved institutions.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for college fee and incidentals.
application_process: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students

scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme
ministry: Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Tamil Nadu
description: Financial assistance for girl students who studied in Tamil Nadu Govt schools from 6th to 12th standard.
eligibility: Female students pursuing higher education who studied in TN Govt schools.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into student bank account.
application_process: Register via Pen Kalvi portal.
name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme

scheme_name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (Women Basic Income Scheme)
ministry: Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Tamil Nadu
description: Rights-based monthly financial assistance scheme for women heads of eligible households.
eligibility: Women heads of families aged above 21 with annual income below ₹2.5 Lakhs.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into women's bank accounts.
application_process: Apply through special camps or e-Sevai centers.
name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (Women Basic Income Scheme)

description: Empowering rural Self-Help Group (SHG) women to start micro-enterprises.
eligibility: Women members of active Day-NRLM Self-Help Groups.
benefits: Skill training, financial literacy, micro-credit access up to ₹5 Lakhs.
application_process: Register via SHG cluster federation.
name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme

description: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 Lakhs to non-corporate small/micro enterprises.
eligibility: Micro enterprises in manufacturing, trading, or service sectors.
benefits: Collateral-free loans: Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), Tarun (₹5L-₹10L).
application_process: Apply via Udyami Mitra portal or commercial banks.
name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)

description: Holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 family-based trades.
eligibility: Traditional artisans working manually with tools in targeted trades.
benefits: Skill stipend ₹500/day, toolkit incentive ₹15,000, credit up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5%.
application_process: Apply via CSC centers on PM Vishwakarma portal.
name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme for Artisans

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Housing for all in urban areas through interest subsidy on housing loans.
eligibility: EWS/LIG/MIG families not owning a pucca house in India.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakhs on housing loans.
application_process: Apply via PMAY MIS portal or bank branch.
name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY-Urban)
